what: DARK-1 is a full dark-music workstation for the FM-1: 21 genres and 210 pieces of dark ambient, industrial, horror, darkwave, dark techno and dungeon synth, all editable down to the details. Dozens of pages of menus shape every part: pad, bass, acid, pluck and drums, the effects, the mix and the sequencer. There are 60 pluck sounds, 37 acid, 30 pad, 30 bass and 22 for each drum. Play along on Jam, draw your own pluck and acid lines on a 16-step dot editor, give the arp its own voice, pick a themed screen, and let Wander shift things on its own when you want it to.
author: Polystellarflow
